sources.label: Material You, ad and tracker removal, and premium unlocks for Android apps.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Stops Detik Analytics and Google Analytics from recording screens and events, and turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Sessions.
Removes the ad banners, native ads, sticky ads and full-screen ads, and the ads on cnnindonesia.com pages opened in the app.
Shows every page of a multi-page article in one continuous article, without the page numbers.
